title: Broken navigation links on Firefox product landing page due to unresolved cross-domain relative paths
evidence: Internal header navigation links on https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/ use root-relative paths that resolve to 404 dead ends on mozilla.org: https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/browsers/enterprise/ (404), https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/whatsnew/ (404), and https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/features/ (404).

suggested_action.summary: Fix relative navigation links on the Firefox subpage or route them to their canonical firefox.com destinations.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Update header navigation links in the Firefox template on mozilla.org to point to absolute URLs on https://www.firefox.com/ or configure reverse-proxy/redirect rules on mozilla.org for /en-US/browsers/enterprise/, /en-US/whatsnew/, and /en-US/features/.

title: Missing breadcrumb structured navigation on deep subpages
evidence: Pages across https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/products/vpn/ and https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/about/ lack Breadcrumb navigation landmarks and BreadcrumbList schema, impairing orientation for users landing directly from search or citations.

suggested_action.summary: Add breadcrumbs with BreadcrumbList schema to product and information pages.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Implement a visual breadcrumb trail (e.g. Home > Products > Mozilla VPN) with semantic <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> and Schema.org BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.
